meta.title: Communication — Members
meta.description: How members build communication skills at Burnaby Entrepreneurs Toastmasters — Competent Communicator and Pathways.

page_hero.headline: Two programmes for building your voice.
page_hero.intro: Members develop their speaking through two paths: the classic Competent Communicator manual and the current Pathways learning experience.

unique_approach.body: Our club has a unique approach to our education compared with other Toastmasters clubs. To learn more please email us.

competent_communicator.heading: Competent Communicator
competent_communicator.intro: The Competent Communicator manual is Toastmasters' original ten-project foundation for public speaking. Members work through the projects at their own pace, each one focused on a specific skill and evaluated against clear criteria.

projects.name: Ice Breaker
projects.objective: Introduce yourself to the club and get comfortable in front of the room.

projects.name: Organize Your Speech
projects.objective: Structure a talk around a clear opening, body, and close so an audience can follow it.

projects.name: Get to the Point
projects.objective: Deliver a focused speech with a single specific purpose the audience walks away with.

projects.name: How to Say It
projects.objective: Choose words with intention — clear, concise, and appropriate to the audience.

projects.name: Your Body Speaks
projects.objective: Use posture, gesture, facial expression, and eye contact to reinforce your message.

projects.name: Vocal Variety
projects.objective: Vary pitch, pace, volume, and tone so the voice carries the meaning as much as the words.

projects.name: Research Your Topic
projects.objective: Build credibility with well-supported material from reliable sources.

projects.name: Get Comfortable with Visual Aids
projects.objective: Design and use visual aids that enhance the message without pulling focus.

projects.name: Persuade with Power
projects.objective: Move an audience to action using logic, emotion, and credibility together.

projects.name: Inspire Your Audience
projects.objective: Deliver a longer, motivational speech that leaves the room energised.

pathways.heading: Pathways
pathways.intro: Pathways is Toastmasters' modern learning experience. Every project ties to a specific competency, includes a rubric for the evaluator, and progresses through five levels — fundamentals first, then increasingly demanding work.
features: Take a short online assessment when you join; it suggests a path based on your goals.
Choose from six paths. New members receive one path free.
Each path has 5 levels — fundamentals, mechanics, tools, style, and reflection/mastery.
Progress is self-paced. You give speeches at club meetings and apply the feedback.
Over 300 practical workplace skills are covered across the programme, in multiple languages.
